pageIntro: MCR works through four pillars—emotional health awareness, emotionally healthy living, multi-disciplinary counseling, and rest & recovery—bringing education, practical care, and space to heal for ministers.

items.title: Building Awareness on Emotional Health
items.description: MCR helps ministers and leaders grow in understanding of emotional well-being. Through teaching, resources, and conversation, we shine a light on what healthy ministry requires. A core part of this pillar is building capacity, equipping people and churches to recognise needs early and respond with wisdom and care.

items.title: Building Awareness on Emotionally Healthy Discipleship
items.description: We champion rhythms and practices that support whole-person health in ministry: sustainable boundaries, connection, and habits that honour both calling and humanity. The goal is not perfection but a way of living and serving that can be maintained with integrity over the long term.

items.title: Counselling Support for Recovery
items.description: Professional counseling is offered through a multi-disciplinary lens, so care can be tailored to the minister, spouse, or family. This brings together appropriate expertise to address emotional and relational health needs in a confidential, respectful setting.

items.title: Rest & Recuperation Support
items.description: MCR provides a dedicated rest and recovery facility for times when ministry has taken a heavy toll. It is a place to step back, breathe, and receive structured support toward renewal, so leaders can recover strength before returning to service, or discern next steps with clarity.
